# GitHub Copilot instructions

This file configures Copilot for this repository. The authoritative, detailed guidance for AI
coding agents (project overview, tech stack, setup, commands, code style, and testing expectations)
lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root — read and follow it before making changes.

In summary: this is the `hmpps-subject-access-request-ui` Node.js/TypeScript (Express + Nunjucks)
application. Use `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run test` to validate changes, and
follow the existing HMPPS/MoJ conventions already present in `server/`.
